tools.name: strategy_seal

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "strategy_seal" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bamboo_training_artifact · Private data: get_bamboo_scene, coop_workshop_get, farm_campaign_get, bamboo_training_run, bamboo_training_explain, bamboo_training_artifact, submit_garden_strategy, entry_create, strategy_validate, strategy_prepare_seal, strategy_seal · Public sink: bamboo_training_artifact, submit_garden_strategy · Destructive: bamboo_challenge_get, coop_workshop_run, farm_workshop_get, farm_workshop_run, farm_autopilot_run, farm_campaign_run, farm_policy_get, farm_policy_validate, farm_policy_run, farm_compare_run, bamboo_training_run, bamboo_training_artifact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bamboo_training_artifact · Private data: get_bamboo_scene, coop_workshop_get, farm_campaign_get, bamboo_training_run, bamboo_training_explain, bamboo_training_artifact, submit_garden_strategy, entry_create, strategy_validate, strategy_prepare_seal, strategy_seal · Public sink: bamboo_training_artifact, submit_garden_strategy · Destructive: bamboo_challenge_get, coop_workshop_run, farm_workshop_get, farm_workshop_run, farm_autopilot_run, farm_campaign_run, farm_policy_get, farm_policy_validate, farm_policy_run, farm_compare_run, bamboo_training_run, bamboo_training_artifact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
